findings.claim: enqueue() now silently clamps out-of-range priority instead of rejecting it, violating INV-2.
findings.failure_scenario: Calling enqueue(queue, 'task-1', 15) previously raised InvalidPriorityError; it now silently creates a Task with priority=9, masking a caller bug and diverging from the documented contract that out-of-range priority must be rejected.
